category_title: English language learners who struggle to comprehend abstract literary nuances without visual aids
scenario_title: Independent reading and comprehension of character roles
minimal_context: Jasmine is reviewing her homework assignment on the novel 'Night' with her tutor in the general classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jasmine, let's look at your homework for the chapter you read in 'Night'. What did you write down for the question about the role of a kapo?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks down at her notebook, hesitating to speak) Um... I just wrote a little bit.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and read what you have.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I wrote... he is a person in the story.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you explain a bit more about what a kapo does in the camp?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks confused and shrinks back in her chair) I don't know. The reading is confusing. I can't explain what his role is.

dialogue_combined:

STUDENT: (Looks down at her notebook, hesitating to speak) Um... I just wrote a little bit.
